title: feat(spec): the list_datasets output declares candidates for a term that matched nothing (ADR-0149 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfR33NbV51QQU6R6bm

Fixes #34761

Clause-②: yes (widening — an optional output field on a published schema)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ask/SKILL.md (zero-match row reads candidates once #34763 lands)
Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`list_datasets` 的返回结构新增可选成员 `candidates`。用户的词在所有列出的数据集里一个成员都没精确命中时,平台列出可供反问的候选成员,每项指向同一份返回里的「数据集 + 成员」,每个词最多 5 个。ADR-0149 D3 末尾加一段只增不改的修订说明。本 PR 只声明形状,不改执行器。
- 为什么改:#34691 F1 的裁决(选 B,记录 6943126855):零命中时由服务器返回候选,任何客户端都读得到,不靠技能或工具描述的措辞。「什么算命中」不变,平台永不替用户选。
- 风险与回滚:只加一个可选输出字段,不带该字段的返回解析结果与之前相同。服务器填充在 #34763,它落地前没有返回会带这个字段,但 MCP 客户端读到的 `outputSchema` 现在就多出这一项。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:① `packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts` 里 `candidates` 的 `.describe()` 文字,它是对外契约,也是 MCP 客户端读到的说明;② `docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md` D3 末尾的修订说明,看它是否如实转述裁决;③ 同一文件里 `DatasetTermCandidateSchema` 不带 `matchedOn`,与卡片提案不同,理由在下面 Schema decisions。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/ai/dataset-tools.test.ts`,预期 `Tests  33 passed (33)`。
- 需要你做的:席位 L2 复核后,亲手合并本 PR(Tier H:`docs/adr/**` 与 `packages/spec/**`)。

## What changes

- **`packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.zod.ts`** (62 lines added, 2 removed; the two removed lines are module doc block lines, rewritten to name `candidates`):
  - `ListDatasetsOutputSchema` gains one optional member, `candidates`: a list of `DatasetTermCandidateSchema` with at least one entry.
  - `DatasetTermCandidateSchema` (type `DatasetTermCandidate`): `{ term, dataset, member }`, all three required. `member` is `DatasetTermMatchSchema`'s `member` by reference, under its own description, so the member-reference format (`measures.NAME` or `dimensions.NAME`) is declared once.
  - `LIST_DATASETS_MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_TERM = 5`, exported.
  - `matches`, `DatasetTermMatchSchema`, `DatasetTermMatchedOn` and every other declaration in the file are untouched.
- **`packages/spec/src/ai/dataset-tools.test.ts`**: seven new cases (33 run in the file now). Six in a new `list_datasets candidates` block, one in the JSON Schema projection block.
- **`packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`**: one pin row for the new alias and the pinned count 857 to 858. `check:spec-parsed-alias` (ADR-0122) refuses a new bare input alias with no pin. See *File surface* below.
- **Generated, by the generators only**: `packages/spec/{api-surface,authorable-surface,declaration-map,export-origins,json-schema.manifest}/ai.json`, `content/docs/references/ai/dataset-tools.mdx`, `content/docs/references/index.mdx` (schema totals 1669 to 1670, AI 81 to 82), `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/ai.md` (96 to 97 object sites).
- **`docs/adr/0149-ai-answers-business-questions-through-the-dataset-semantic-layer.md`**: an amendment note at the end of D3, in ADR-0011's `> **Amendment note**` form. 11 lines added, 0 removed or changed.
- **`.changeset/34761-list-datasets-candidates.md`**: `@objectstack/spec` at `minor`.
- Nothing under `packages/services/service-analytics/**`, `packages/mcp/**` or `skills/**`.

## Why

Ruled by the maintainer on #34691, fork F1, option B, option text verbatim 「B 零命中返回候选」 — 「现在就改服务器，list_datasets 零命中时返回候选数据集。专题席的新推荐。」 (ruling record `6943126855`, relayed to #34659 as `6943149235`). It re-rules point E2 of #34659's record `6940528935` to that point's option A.

With `terms`, `list_datasets` answers the whole admitted catalogue, and a term with no match gets no pointer to the near members (the card's reading of `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts`), so what to do next is left to each client. A tool result is read by every client that made the call; a tool description is read only after the client picked the tool, and a skill only when it is installed and triggered.

This PR is the spec half: the shape, and the record. The executor that fills the list and the tool descriptions are #34763.

## Schema decisions

The card's proposal was a starting point ("the PR settles it and says why if it differs"). One point differs.

| Point | Card's proposal | Settled here | Why |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Entry shape | `{ term, dataset, member, matchedOn }` | `{ term, dataset, member }` | **Differs.** `matchedOn` says which of the member's words the term equals after normalization. A candidate has no such equality, so the key would state something false. There is no "near which word" key either: D3 rule 1 names an embedding neighbour among the non-hits that may be offered, and an embedding neighbour is near no single word. Such a key would presume a substring or stem rule, and the rule is the executor's. |
| What the question lists | not stated | read from `datasets` | D3 rule 3 lists label, dataset label and description. Each candidate points at a member listed in the same answer, so the client reads those from that `datasets` entry. The entry repeats none of them. |
| Presence | only when `terms` were sent and a term matched no member of any listed dataset | as proposed, as `.min(1).optional()` | "No candidates" has one spelling, the key's absence. An empty list does not parse. An answer without the key parses to the same value as before. |
| Order | terms as sent, datasets as listed, measures before dimensions, no score | as proposed | Stated in the member's description. It is a listing order and the description says it is not a ranking. A schema cannot enforce an order; holding it is the executor's (#34763). |
| Cap | an exported per-term constant, proposed 5 | `LIST_DATASETS_MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_TERM = 5` | The description states the cap from the constant. The list is flat (one list for all terms), so the schema carries no per-term `maxItems`: nothing in this PR refuses a sixth entry for one term. |
| Description text | not a match, for a clarifying question, never selected, only members this caller may read | as proposed, as facts | ADR-0149 M1 A keeps AI guidance out of the spec. The description says what a candidate is. How to ask stays in the tool description (#34763). |
| Near-match rule | the server sibling's | not in the spec | The spec and the ADR note say what a candidate is, not how one is found. |

The new type alias is a bare input alias with a pin, not an alias paired with a `Parsed` twin: the schema has no default and no transform, so input and output types are the same (ADR-0122).

## Prior rulings read

The claim names four. None is crossed.

- **ADR-0078, the hit labelled "Decision §8"**: the text is its section 5, "Ratchet, not retrofit", where "candidates" means audit findings. It rules nothing about a tool output.
- **ADR-0110 D2**: handler-key candidates derived from an action declaration. Unrelated.
- **ADR-0149 D2** (two tools, one definition, one executor, two transports): this PR adds one optional member to the one definition. No second definition, no executor and no transport changes. The output members D2 lists stand as written, and the D3 note names the added one.
- **ADR-0149 D6** (every key names its reader in its first implementation card): the note's "State on `main`" bullet names #34763 as the card that fills the list and carries the branch to the model. The spec liveness ledger classifies authorable metadata keys and has no row for the dataset-tool output schemas; `check:liveness` exits 0 and asked for no row.

## Tests

Readings are on head `666309be` with a clean working tree, unless a row says otherwise.

| Command | Result |
|:--|:--|
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/ai/dataset-tools.test.ts src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` (verify lock) | `Test Files  2 passed (2)`, `Tests  36 passed (36)`; lock line `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` then `test` (verify lock), on `a23b07c9` | `check:test-typecheck: OK`; `Test Files  847 passed \| 1 skipped (848)`; `Tests  27175 passed \| 1 skipped \| 1 todo (27177)`; `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The one later commit, `666309be`, changes one sentence of the ADR note. |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics test` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test` (verify lock) | service-analytics `Test Files  218 passed (218)`, `Tests  5548 passed \| 335 skipped (5883)`; mcp `Test Files  66 passed (66)`, `Tests  1226 passed (1226)`; `VERDICT command-exit 0` |
| `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the three changed TypeScript files | exit 0, no finding |

The two downstream packages are the ones outside spec that import the dataset-tool schemas (direction: consumers of spec). They ran against a spec `dist/` that carries the new export.

<details><summary>What the new cases pin</summary>

- An answer with `candidates` parses, and the parsed value keeps the list.
- An answer without the key parses to the same value as before.
- An empty `candidates` list is refused, at path `candidates`.
- An entry's keys are exactly `dataset`, `member`, `term`, each required, and there is no `matchedOn`.
- `member` takes what a match's `member` takes and refuses what it refuses.
- The cap constant is 5.
- The projected `list_datasets` `outputSchema` has `candidates` as an array with `minItems` 1 whose items require `term`, `dataset` and `member`, and `candidates` is not in the output's `required` list.

The built `dist/` answers the same: `required` is `["datasets"]`; `candidates` is `type: array`, `minItems: 1`; its items are `type: object`, `required: ["term","dataset","member"]`, `additionalProperties: false`.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (three, each restored)</summary>

Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `dataset-tools.zod.ts`, and each restore ended with "ok restored: blob == HEAD (bbb4dce7b5b8) and `git diff HEAD` is empty". The suite imports the schema by relative path from `src/`, so there is no `dist/` leg.

| Mutation | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| `.min(1)` to `.min(0)` on `candidates` | `Tests  2 failed \| 31 passed (33)`: the empty-list case and the projection case |
| the key `candidates` renamed | `Tests  3 failed \| 30 passed (33)`: the keep-the-list case, the empty-list case, the projection case |
| `member` to a plain string | `Tests  1 failed \| 32 passed (33)`: the member-format case |

The first attempt at the first ablation did not run. The tool refused it (the replacement text was a substring of the anchor, so the count moved 18 to 18) and restored the file. The row above is the second attempt with a narrower anchor.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The key is declared and nothing fills it yet.** Until #34763 lands no answer carries `candidates`. The tool's `outputSchema` lists the optional member from this PR on. The ADR note says so in its last bullet.
- **File surface.** Three files are beyond the list in the claim. `content/docs/references/index.mdx` and `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/ai.md` are generator output (`gen:docs`, `gen:strictness-ledger`). `packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` is a hand edit that `check:spec-parsed-alias` demands for any new bare input alias.
- **Overlap with open PR #34719.** `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` exits 1: both PRs move the totals in `content/docs/references/index.mdx` and the pinned count in `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`. `origin/main` merges cleanly. Whichever lands second merges `main`, re-runs `gen:docs` and sets the count to the sum.
- **Pending: the #34720 qualifier.** As the seat relayed it to this dev, #34720 is ruled (record `6946563869`; not read here) and rule 1 of D3 will need a qualifier for it. Card #34761 does not carry that amendment (body and both comments re-read after the last commit; the card was last updated 2026-11-17T10:53:47Z), so this note does not write it. The note is one self-contained block and changes no existing D3 sentence, so a later sentence can be added to it.
- **The ruling record's "note that several readings may exist".** Record `6943126855` describes candidates as "near matches, with a note that several readings may exist". This PR carries that as the member's description ("possible readings of a term ... for a clarifying question"), not as a text field in the result. A result field for it would be a second, per-answer copy of guidance text, which M1 A keeps out of the spec. Raised in the dev report as an open question.
- **No second pointer under D2.** D2's "Output" sentence is unchanged (the note is add-only), and the D3 note names D2.
- **The entry is a plain `z.object`.** The strictness count for `ai/` moves 96 to 97 object sites; `ai/` is an untriaged directory in that ledger.
- **The skill file in the `Skills-docs:` line** arrives with PR #34792 and is not on `main` yet.
- **Shallow clone.** This checkout is shallow. No claim here rests on history dates or ancestry.
